scope: current-version repository cleanup and pre-commit candidate verification
verification_method: git archive of staged tree into a fresh empty directory, not an independent Git clone
preserved_sources: original character art, prompts, Aseprite projects, musical sources, licenses, exact input bytes and user rhythm records retained
git_status: local commit and read-only GitHub lookup are performed after this record is finalized; Git log and final user report own those results
limits: Full check can regenerate one historical skill QA report audio_teardown field in the candidate; it was not copied back over the index.
Cold-import caches, generated raw captures, external action-study downloads and test builds remain local and outside Git.
Credential scanning covered common private-key/GitHub/OpenAI/AWS token patterns, not a proof against every possible secret.
Some immutable licenses, user CSVs, historical patches and raw logs have retained whitespace diagnostics; no global reformatting was performed.
